chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Teaches Black Tai Sui & Reunites with Tuoba Danqing — Daode Guiyi Xian Ch. 314
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang eats Black Tai Sui for breakfast, tries teaching it the Three Character Classic, and negotiates a bagua mirror trade with Tuoba Danqing. Quiet horror with a side of martial-world politics.
og_title: Li Huowang's Parasite Tutor: Yinling City Chapter
og_description: Feeding, teaching, and trading—Li Huowang's new routine is disturbingly domestic. A must-read for fans of slow-burn supernatural horror.
twitter_title: He's Teaching a Parasite to Read the Classics
twitter_description: Li Huowang eats Black Tai Sui, recites the Three Character Classic, and talks shop with Tuoba Danqing. The quietest chapter of horror you'll ever love.

lore_anchors.definition: A foundational Confucian primer from the Song dynasty, composed entirely of three-character lines. Li Huowang uses it in a futile attempt to teach literacy to a parasitic flesh entity inside his belly.

A Daoist ritual bronze mirror engraved with the eight trigrams, used for feng shui, exorcism, and reflection of evil. Here, it has a secret activation technique that Li Huowang cannot currently access.
A fictional sect in the novel fusing Zoroastrianism (袄教) and Nestorian Christianity (景教); its cultivation philosophy relies on voluntarily enduring extreme physical suffering for power.
A classic jianghu (martial world) proverb emphasizing that personal connections are the most valuable currency for survival and advancement.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang eat the Black Tai Sui?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He consumes it to keep its power/symbiosis active inside his body; the Black Tai Sui is now a living part of his internal ecosystem that he can "teach" from the inside.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the bagua mirror trade?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Tuoba Danqing found a blind Daoist (originally duped by the Zuowandao) who wants the mirror back. The Daoist offers a set of talisman manuals in exchange instead of the mirror's activation technique.
He's presented as a "brother in the Office," but his advice is pragmatic and self-interested. Treat him as a useful ally with his own agenda, not a pure friend.
